completion_promises.evidence: The serve-nats Click subcommand at src/study_tutor/cli/main.py:625-674 declares all three options via @click.option. Verified by running 'python -m study_tutor.cli.main serve-nats --help' which prints all three flags in the Options section, and by the unit test test_serve_nats_help_lists_required_flags which asserts each flag string appears in --help output (passing).

completion_promises.criterion_text: study-tutor serve-nats --nats nats://localhost:4222 starts the adapter, blocks until SIGTERM, then shuts down cleanly.
completion_promises.evidence: _serve_adapter (src/study_tutor/cli/main.py:529-622) awaits adapter.start(), installs SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers, awaits the shared shutdown_event, then runs adapter.stop() and runtime_shutdown(write_helper) in nested finally blocks. The CLI body in serve_nats applies the --nats override to config.nats.url before constructing the runtime. Verified by test_serve_adapter_starts_then_stops_when_shutdown_event_is_set (asserts start.assert_awaited_once + stop.assert_awaited_once when the shutdown event is set) and test_serve_nats_flag_overrides_config_nats_url (asserts the --nats CLI flag mutates config.nats.url before _build_nats_runtime is invoked). Both tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: SIGTERM during a running tutor process triggers adapter.stop() and the process exits with code 0 within the drain window (30s).
completion_promises.evidence: Signal handlers for SIGINT and SIGTERM are registered via loop.add_signal_handler(sig, _request_shutdown). _request_shutdown sets the shared asyncio.Event, which unblocks the await and runs adapter.stop() (NATSAdapter owns the 30s drain timeout per TASK-NATS-PH1-005 scope) followed by runtime_shutdown(write_helper). On the happy path no SystemExit is raised so the process exits 0. Verified by test_serve_adapter_registers_sigterm_and_sigint_handlers (asserts both signal.SIGTERM and signal.SIGINT are passed to loop.add_signal_handler) and the BDD scenario 'SIGTERM during an in-flight tutor turn drains the request before deregistration' in features/nats-fleet-integration/by-task/TASK-NATS-PH1-006.feature, which passes via test_TASK-NATS-PH1-006.py.

completion_promises.criterion_text: If nats-core's AgentConfig validation fails (e.g. invalid NATS_URL), the CLI exits 1 with a clear error message.
completion_promises.evidence: _load_agent_config (src/study_tutor/cli/main.py:423-446) wraps any AgentConfig() construction failure in the typed _AgentConfigValidationError. The serve_nats Click command catches that exception, emits '[study-tutor] Error: AgentConfig validation failed: {exc.cause}' to stderr (preserving the underlying pydantic field names so an operator can find the missing env var), and raises SystemExit(1). _serve_adapter independently exits 1 when adapter.start() raises (with a separate banner and best-effort stop()). Verified by test_serve_nats_exits_1_when_agent_config_validation_fails (asserts exit code 1, banner present, and underlying field name AGENT_MODELS__REASONING_MODEL flows through into stderr) and test_serve_adapter_exits_1_when_start_raises (asserts SystemExit(1) and that stop() is still awaited on a start failure). Both pass.
